svg.title: Browser load, GC, and memory: 1 document(s)
svg.desc: Each row combines the complete measured readiness time and its constituent stages with GC and memory diagnostics. GC is already inside elapsed time, not added to it. High-water memory is sampled, not an exact peak. Numeric equivalents appear in the report table.
svg.text: 1 document(s): the whole browser load, with GC and memory on the same row
Same logical format → JSON / binary encoding → object adapter / direct loader. Lower is better.
¹Separate trace pass; GC is not extra time. ²Observed high-water, not exact peak. ³Post-GC retained increment. ⁴Sampled JS allocations, separate pass.
